items.label: On the ballot
items.text: Mission Local (Oct. 8, 2026) says the District 4 incumbent "won handily in June" and is "on track to win the next four-year term". Search summaries: the sf.gov candidate report says 3 people qualified for District 4; GrowSF and Wikipedia list Wong, Albert Chow and Jeremy Greco. (sources: Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/10/sf-meet-the-candidates-congress-supervisor-school-board/ [fetched page, secondary]; San Francisco Department of Elections https://www.sf.gov/reports--candidates-nov-3-2026-general-election [search summary, primary]; GrowSF https://growsf.org/voter-guide/san-francisco-voter-guide-november-2026-election/contests/district-4-supervisor/ [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_San_Francisco_Board_of_Supervisors_election [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Incumbent
items.text: Yes, appointed. Mission Local (Nov. 30, 2025): "Mayor Lurie taps Alan Wong as District 4 supervisor, its 3rd of 2025" (after the Sept. 2025 recall of Joel Engardio and Beya Alcaraz's one-week tenure); Mission Local (Dec. 1, 2025) reports the swearing-in on Monday. CivLab lists him as D4 Supervisor, type "appointed", from 2025-12-01. He won the June 2, 2026 special election for the rest of Engardio's term (Mission Local: "a 65-35 margin"). (sources: Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2025/11/alan-wong-to-be-named-third-district-4-supervisor-of-2025/ [fetched page, secondary]; Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2025/12/sf-alan-wong-district-supervisor-sunset/ [fetched page, secondary]; CivLab (Michael Adams), SF Gov Graph data https://graph.civlab.org/sf [fetched page, secondary]; Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/06/sf-sunset-district-4-natalie-gee-exit-race/ [fetched page, secondary])

items.label: Occupation
items.text: Mission Local profile (June 2026 election series), Job: "Current District 4 Supervisor / Commander in California’s National Guard". (sources: Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/05/sf-election-district-4-sunset-candidates/ [fetched page, secondary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Member, Board of Supervisors, District 4, appointed by Mayor Daniel Lurie (CivLab start 2025-12-01); won the June 2, 2026 special election. Mission Local (Dec. 1, 2025): "Wong was elected to the City College Board of Trustees in 2020, and reelected in 2024"; the same article says he worked as an aide to former District 4 Supervisor Gordon Mar from 2019 to 2023. In his own Q&A answer he says he served as "President of the City College Board". (sources: CivLab (Michael Adams), SF Gov Graph data https://graph.civlab.org/sf [fetched page, secondary]; Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2025/12/sf-alan-wong-district-supervisor-sunset/ [fetched page, secondary]; Mission Local https://missionlocal.org/2026/05/sf-election-district-4-sunset-candidates/ [fetched page, secondary])
